title: Moonrise Guard's Key
summary: Opens most doors in Moonrise Towers. Prison cell grates use their own levers.

fields.Use: Unlocks most Moonrise Towers doors. The prison cell grates are lever-operated from the Warden’s office.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by the Warden and multiple acolytes, adepts and zealots in the towers.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
